sections.markdown:
## E2 — Competitive teardown: basic driving: starting, moving, stopping, steering methods and backing up
No competitor was reviewed in this pass; names, prices, structure, pedagogy, practice style, praise, complaints and coverage are open (SC-BAS-TEARDOWN).
Adopt and beat lists stay empty until at least two named, priced competitors are examined from their own store or review pages.
Angle to test later: competitors may still teach the two and ten grip; following the manual's lower hand positions and its air bag reason could be a beat point once verified.

corpus_stability.reason: The South Carolina Driver's Manual prints a single edition line (Revised 06/2024) on its front cover; its disclaimer says legislative and SCDMV policy changes may make some content out of date until the agency incorporates them, and a possibly newer unlinked upload exists on the issuer site (freshness debt in the run jams), so the corpus is treated as revised at most about once a year, bound to the registered snapshot.

verification_debt.claim_text: Competitive teardown of South Carolina permit-test prep products for the basic driving: starting, moving, stopping, steering methods and backing up topic is unresearched.
